card.name: Disclaimer wording in notices
card.fires_on: Words inside disclaimer and legal-notice sentences, such as 'intended' in 'This product is intended for use' and 'opinions' in 'Any opinions, findings, and conclusions'. Also fires on 'practitioner' in warning lines.

modes.label: Product intended-use statements
modes.description: The word 'intended' or 'for' in a 'This product is intended for...' warning or disclaimer.
modes.example: WARNINGS This product is<< intended>> for use by physicians who are experienced in

modes.label: Grant and opinion disclaimers
modes.description: Words in the funding notice 'based upon work supported by... Any opinions, findings, and conclusions'.
modes.example: These materials are based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under grant number DUE-0402553 Any<< opinions>>, findings, and conclusions or recommendations

modes.label: The line about seeking a practitioner's advice
modes.description: The ending of 'licensed health care practitioner' in warning bullets.
modes.example: ​WARNINGS: • ​If sumptoms persist or worsen ​, seek advice of licensed health care<< practitioner>>. • ​If pregnant or nursing ​

card.writes: It pushes toward copyright and legal-statement words like ©, copyright, hereby and statement.
card.plain: It marks the stock wording of disclaimers and legal notices, where the text is about what a product or page is meant for.
